You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important was the Battle of the Marne to the nature of the fighting on the Western Front by
the end of 1914? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were the military campaigns on the Eastern Front to the outcome of the war? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important was the Munich Putsch to Nazi Party support and membership by 1930? Explain
your answer.
How significant was racial policy in bringing about the kind of society the Nazis wanted after 1933?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was the secret police (Okhrana) in the maintenance of Tsarist rule up to 1914?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was Stalin’s control of religion and culture in creating a totalitarian state in the Soviet
Union after 1928? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was the entertainment industry as an aspect of the ‘Roaring Twenties’? Explain
your answer.
How significant a part of the New Deal were the Alphabet Agencies? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important were improved relations with the USA in China’s foreign policy after 1970? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant were changes in education to the development of China after 1949? Explain your
answer.
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was gold mining in shaping the economic development of South Africa by 1948?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was international opposition in challenging apartheid? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was pressure from the USA as a reason for the British withdrawal from Palestine
in 1948? Explain your answer.
How significant was Jordan in Arab-Israeli relations after 1948? Explain your answer.
